test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: According to the Union Budget 2022, the overall workforce participation rate in India is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is "**20.3%".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **Union Budget 2022, 18.2% of India's population** is currently living in **urban areas, **making the country's overall workforce participation **rate 20.3%.**
 
• In 2022, there will be **more women employed (51.44%),** compared to** 41.25% in 2021.**
 
• India has one of the lowest rates of female labour force participation in the world, with fewer than one-third of the population being female, according to the **World Bank.**
 
• It also points out that **India's female labour force** participation rate, which was over **26% in 2005 **but fell to **19% in 2020**, was lower than that of **Bangladesh (35%) and Sri Lanka (31%)**, two other nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The issue grew worse as more urban women lost their jobs or left their occupations during the period due to the **Covid-19 pandemic.**
 
• It hit a record-low **15.5%** in the first quarter of the lockdown, from **April to June.**
 
• **The Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS)** conducted by the **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation** found that female labour force participation had somewhat grown over the years prior to the pandemic's arrival in our country and stood at** 22.8% in FY20.**
 
• According to **Deloitte India, more than 65% of women** wanted to leave their employment both during the pandemic and a year later.
